nombre_oficial.texto: The Ciudadela and the City Center

frase_gancho.texto: Where power, faith, and the marketplace came together.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: At the southern end of the Avenue lies the navel of Teotihuacán. Here the city’s great axes cross, and two opposing plazas stand face to face: the Citadel, a sunken, enclosed courtyard where the elite ruled, and the Great Compound, an open esplanade where the main market probably stood. At the far end of the courtyard, the Temple of the Feathered Serpent awaits you, its facade of stone heads hidden behind a platform; the side palaces of the priests; the tunnel sealed with mercury beneath the plaza; and the bridge where the San Juan River was forced to turn ninety degrees.
